dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What goods did you bring with you?

dialogues.speaker: Hinaeia Nui
dialogues.text: Heehee, just some specialties from the People of the Springs!

dialogues.speaker: Hinaeia Nui
dialogues.text: That said... Maybe it's because of the difference in temperature, but most of our products aren't very suited to local use...

dialogues.speaker: Hinaeia Nui
dialogues.text: Thank goodness our instruments are still popular! We do have to keep an eye on changes in the wood due to temperature shifts during transport, but it's only a minor inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Hinaeia Nui
dialogues.text: Seems like people love music no matter where they are! Isn't that nice?
